payload.summary: All 12 failures came from 10.77.0.20, the only source svc_backup has ever logged in from, at the same 01:00 time it logs in every night. They arrive at a steady 30-second interval and stop with a normal login from the same host at 01:14. This matches a scheduled job retrying with an outdated password, not password guessing.
risk_factors: Repeated failed logins, although from the account's usual source
